# vendor/rtk

Verbatim copies from rtk-ai/rtk (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt) for the yi-tools::reduce port (YI_DESIGN.md T17).
Only toml_filter.rs, guard.rs, truncate.rs, utils.rs (strip_ansi/truncate), build.rs and filters/*.toml are ported wholesale; the cmds files are reference for à-la-carte pure filters.
